description:
Create and immediately send a new envelope from a saved template.
    Get template_id and roles from list_templates. Supply at least one
    recipient, e.g. [{"name": "...", "email": "...", "role": "signer"}],
    covering the template's field roles. Use role_mapping to rename template
    roles to recipient roles, e.g. {"customer": "client"}; unmapped roles
    stay unchanged. Use send_envelope for new PDF files, send_draft for an
    existing draft, or add_document_to_draft(template_id=...) to append to an
    existing draft without sending.

    The template is unchanged. A successful send normally costs 1 credit
    and sends invitations unless send_invite=false. Set
    send_completion_email=false separately to suppress signer completion
    emails. sequential defaults true (one at a time). prefill =
    {"party:name": "text"} overrides text defaults for this send only.
    metadata.revision_of may name a changes-requested source document_id for
    its one-time free resend while the promotion is enabled.

    If sending fails after the draft is created, the error includes draft_id.
    The draft does not store recipients or send options. To retry without
    creating a second draft, call send_draft with document_id=draft_id and
    supply recipients and any send options again. Requires envelopes:send
    access.
name: send_from_template
title: Send From Template
